{{Quote|It is the determination of this court that Valin Horn is not competent to stand trial for his actions in the above-named suit. This court has further determined that the defendant, because of the extraordinary dangerous nature of his abilities and the overt criminality of his mental illness, is too dangerous to be confined in any conventional prison.|Judge Zudan|<ref name="Fate of the Jedi: Outcast">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Outcast]]''</ref>}}
'''''The Galactic Federation of Free Alliances versus Valin Horn''''' was a legal case between the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances]] and [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Valin Horn]], who had recently suffered a [[Force psychosis|psychotic breakdown]]. The judge of the case was [[Mavari Zudan]], a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Falleen/Legends|Falleen]], and Horn's lawyer was the [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Nawara Ven]]. It was decided that Horn was incompetent to stand trial, but that he was also too dangerous to be simply confined in a conventional [[Prison/Legends|prison]]. Therefore, it was ruled that Horn would be [[Carbon-freezing/Legends|encased]] in [[Carbonite/Legends|carbonite]] and placed in the [[Armand Isard Correctional Facility]]. This would eventually lead to a [[Raid on the Armand Isard Correctional Facility|rescue mission]] attempted by rogue [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] Knight [[Seff Hellin]], who was suffering from the same psychosis as Horn.
